scenario: LEXP.7.20: a read of a schema-typed slot is a fact reference ([LGRA.5.7a.2]), so `Child c, Child d where c.parent < d.parent` is refused with DS_VALIDATE_UNORDERED_TYPE at the `<`. Neither operand is a pattern binding, so only the slot reads' type can refuse it. PATH PINNED: `dsc.typecheck` `adjacent_mismatches`, keyed on an operand typed `lk_fact` (`fact_operand`); a schema-typed slot types as `lk_fact` through `luni_7_1_slot_type`. A check keyed on an operand being a pattern binding compiles this source.
